purpose: Define listener/port bindings as mutable configuration/runtime bindings attached to stable named service instances across HTTP, REST, OSC, WebSocket and other installed protocols.

owns: Runtime Listener and Port Binding semantics

topics.name: Listeners
topics.purpose: Define listener/port bindings as mutable configuration/runtime bindings attached to stable named service instances across HTTP, REST, OSC, WebSocket and other installed protocols.

semantics.identity_rule: Listener binding is not service semantic identity.
semantics.port_rule: Port is a binding value only.
semantics.collision_rule: Conflicting active bindings hard-fail unless protocol/transport semantics explicitly permit coexistence.
semantics.editor_rule: Port/listener editors edit canonical configuration/lifecycle operations; they do not own service semantics.
semantics.runtime_rule: Running listener state is runtime state; declared binding is configuration semantics.

invariants.rule: Network/service identity, binding, lifecycle and authority remain explicit and separate.

hard_gates.condition: port treated as service semantic identity
listener editor creates private runtime authority
running state conflated with declared binding
protocol/transport omitted where required for deterministic binding

references.purpose: Bindings attach to stable named instances.
Declared binding and runtime state remain separate.

prose.summary: Define listener/port bindings as mutable configuration/runtime bindings attached to stable named service instances across HTTP, REST, OSC, WebSocket and other installed protocols.
